entities.summary: The Battle of Pressburg, or Battle of Pozsony, or Battle of Bratislava was a three-day-long battle fought between 4 and 6 July 907, during which the East Francian army, consisting mainly of Bavarian troops led by Margrave Luitpold, was annihilated by Hungarian forces.
